---

## Very Thorough Exploration Report: DateField & Calendar Implementation Patterns

I've conducted a deep analysis of both the **DateField** and **Calendar** state-machine components. Here's a comprehensive map of their implementation patterns, critical for DatePicker composition:

---

### **DATEFIELD COMPONENT**

#### **1. Type Definitions**

**State Enum** (`date_field/mod.rs:38-45`)
```rust
pub enum State {
    Idle,                        // No segment focused
    Focused(DateSegmentKind),    // Specific segment has keyboard focus
}
```

**Event Enum** (`date_field/mod.rs:47-91`)
- `FocusSegment(DateSegmentKind)` — user focused a segment
- `BlurAll` — focus left the entire field
- `IncrementSegment(DateSegmentKind)` / `DecrementSegment(DateSegmentKind)` — arrow key navigation
- `TypeIntoSegment(DateSegmentKind, char)` — character input
- `TypeBufferCommit(DateSegmentKind)` — commit type-ahead buffer (effect-driven, ~1s timer)
- `CompositionStart` / `CompositionEnd(DateSegmentKind, String)` — IME handling
- `ClearSegment(DateSegmentKind)` / `ClearAll` — backspace/delete/escape
- `SetValue(Option<CalendarDate>)` — programmatic value update
- `SyncProps(Box<Props>)` — props change synchronization
- `FocusNextSegment` / `FocusPrevSegment` — Tab/Shift+Tab navigation

**Context Struct** (`date_field/mod.rs:355-419`)
- `value: Bindable<Option<CalendarDate>>` — single controlled/uncontrolled date value
- `segments: Vec<DateSegment>` — segments in display order
- `focused_segment: Option<DateSegmentKind>` — current keyboard focus target
- `type_buffer: String` — accumulated typed characters for type-ahead
- `pending_controlled_value: Option<Option<CalendarDate>>` — deferred external value (when user is editing)
- `is_composing: bool` — IME composition flag
- `locale: Locale` — resolved locale
- `intl_backend: Arc<dyn IntlBackend>` — i18n backend
- `messages: Messages` — localized segment labels
- `calendar: CalendarSystem` — active calendar (Gregorian, Japanese, etc.)
- `granularity: DateGranularity` — precision (currently only `Day`)
- `disabled: bool` / `readonly: bool`
- `min_value: Option<CalendarDate>` / `max_value: Option<CalendarDate>` — constraints
- `ids: ComponentIds` — derived part IDs
- `invalid: bool` — validation state
- `error_message_id: String` — aria reference
- `force_leading_zeros: bool` — formatting flag

**Props Struct** (`date_field/mod.rs:101-170`)
- `id: String` — stable component ID
- `value: Option<Option<CalendarDate>>` — controlled value (None=uncontrolled, Some(None)=empty, Some(date)=date)
- `default_value: Option<CalendarDate>` — uncontrolled initial
- `calendar: CalendarSystem`
- `granularity: DateGranularity`
- `min_value / max_value: Option<CalendarDate>`
- `disabled / readonly / required / auto_focus: bool`
- `label: String` — visible label text
- `aria_label / aria_labelledby / aria_describedby: Option<String>`
- `description / error_message: Option<String>`
- `invalid: bool`
- `name: Option<String>` — hidden input name for forms
- `segment_order: Option<Vec<DateSegmentKind>>` — optional override for segment layout
- `force_leading_zeros: bool`

**Part Enum** (`date_field/mod.rs:1247-1279`)
- `Root` — outer container
- `Label` — visible label
- `FieldGroup` — group of all segments (role="group")
- `Segment { kind: DateSegmentKind }` — individual segment (role="spinbutton")
- `Literal { index: usize }` — non-editable separator
- `Description` — help text element
- `ErrorMessage` — error alert
- `HiddenInput` — form input (type="hidden", ISO8601 value)

**Effect Enum** (`date_field/mod.rs:893-897`)
- `TypeBufferCommit` — timer effect for type-ahead auto-commit (~1s delay)

**Messages Struct** (`date_field/mod.rs:840-871`)
- Localized labels: `year_label`, `month_label`, `day_label`, `hour_label`, `minute_label`, `second_label`, `day_period_label`, `era_label`, `weekday_label`, `timezone_label`

#### **2. Machine Trait Implementation** (`date_field/mod.rs:899-1244`)

**`Machine` struct marker** — empty unit struct implementing `ars_core::Machine` trait

**`init()` method** (`line 912-965`)
- Signature: `fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context)`
- Creates `Bindable` for value (controlled vs uncontrolled)
- Resolves calendar system from locale
- Calls `ctx.rebuild_segments()` to construct initial segment list
- Sets initial state to `Focused(first_editable)` if `auto_focus && !disabled`, else `Idle`
- **Returns**: `(State, Context)` tuple

**`on_props_changed()` method** (`line 967-978`)
- Asserts `props.id` stability
- Returns `vec![Event::SyncProps(...)]` if props differ, else `Vec::new()`

**`transition()` method** (`line 980-1229`)
- Guards against disabled state (except `SetValue`, `SyncProps`, `CompositionEnd`)
- Large match over all `Event` variants
- Returns `Option<TransitionPlan<Machine>>`
- Uses `.apply(|ctx: &mut Context| {...})` closures to mutate context
- Manages `PendingEffect::named(Effect::TypeBufferCommit)` for type-buffer timeout
- **Key pattern**: type-ahead values auto-advance to next segment when `buffered_value * 10 > max` or buffer length >= digit count

**`connect()` method** (`line 1231-1243`)
- Signature: `fn connect<'a>(...) -> Self::Api<'a>`
- Returns `Api { state, ctx, props, send }`

#### **3. Connect API Surface** (`date_field/mod.rs:1281-1688`)

**Api struct** — lifetimed reference holder to state/ctx/props/send

**Attribute methods** (each returns `AttrMap`):
- `root_attrs()` — sets `data-ars-state` (idle/focused), `data-ars-disabled`, `data-ars-readonly`, `data-ars-invalid`
- `label_attrs()` — id, role=group, aria labels
- `field_group_attrs()` — role="group", aria-label (from label or aria_label or labelledby), aria-required, aria-described-by
- `segment_attrs(&DateSegmentKind)` — role="spinbutton", aria-label, aria-valuemin/max/now, aria-value-text, tabindex
- `literal_attrs(index: usize)` — aria-hidden
- `description_attrs()` / `error_message_attrs()` / `hidden_input_attrs()`

**Value accessor**:
- `pub fn value(&self) -> Option<&CalendarDate>` — returns `ctx.value.get().as_ref()` (line 1653-1657)

**Segment access**:
- `pub fn segments(&self) -> &[DateSegment]` — returns `&ctx.segments`

**State**:
- `pub fn is_focused(&self) -> bool` — `!matches!(state, State::Idle)`

**Event handlers** (call `self.send()` with events):
- `on_field_group_focusout(focus_leaving_group: bool)` → `Event::BlurAll`
- `on_segment_keydown(kind, KeyboardEventData, shift, dir)` → various `Event`s
- `on_segment_focus(kind)` → `Event::FocusSegment(kind)`
- `on_segment_click(kind)` → `Event::FocusSegment(kind)`
- `on_segment_composition_start()` / `on_segment_composition_end(kind, text)`

#### **4. Key Value Type for Sync**

**Primary value type: `CalendarDate` from `ars_i18n`**
- Methods used: `year()`, `month()`, `day()`, `era()`, `to_iso8601()`, `clone()`
- Returned by: `Api::value()` → `Option<&CalendarDate>`
- Set via: `Event::SetValue(Option<CalendarDate>)`
- **Also available in context**: `Context.assemble_date() -> Option<CalendarDate>` (line 507-523) — builds date from current segment values

#### **5. Sub-machine / Nested Composition**

**DateSegment** (`date_field/segment.rs`)
- `pub struct DateSegment` with: `kind, value: Option<i32>, min, max, text: String, placeholder, literal, is_editable`
- Not a state machine itself; just data structure held in context
- Public constructors: `new_numeric()`, `new_literal()`, `new_non_editable()`
- Helper: `display_text()` returns text or placeholder; `aria_value_text()` for accessible label

**No sub-machines**: DateField is atomic; does not embed Calendar or other machines

#### **6. Module Layout**

```
crates/ars-components/src/date_time/
  date_field/
    mod.rs           (2369 lines) — main machine
    segment.rs       (205 lines) — DateSegment data struct
    tests.rs         (not shown)
  calendar/
    mod.rs           (2192 lines) — main machine
    grid.rs          (303 lines) — grid math helpers
    tests.rs         (not shown)
  mod.rs             (11 lines) — re-exports:
                       pub mod calendar;
                       pub mod date_field;
                       pub mod time_field;
```

**Re-exports from date_field/mod.rs** (line 35):
```rust
pub use segment::{DateSegment, DateSegmentKind};
```

The crate root (`src/lib.rs`) exposes `pub mod date_time` which then exposes both `pub mod calendar` and `pub mod date_field`.

---

### **CALENDAR COMPONENT**

#### **1. Type Definitions**

**State Enum** (`calendar/mod.rs:71-77`)
```rust
pub enum State {
    Idle,      // No cell has keyboard focus
    Focused,   // A date cell holds keyboard focus
}
```

**Event Enum** (`calendar/mod.rs:81-160`)
- `FocusDate { date: CalendarDate }` — move focus to specific date (clamped to min/max)
- `SelectDate { date: CalendarDate }` — select in single mode; falls through to `ToggleDate` in multi
- `ToggleDate { date: CalendarDate }` — toggle date in/out of multi-selection set
- `NextMonth` / `PrevMonth` — step by `page_behavior` amount
- `NextYear` / `PrevYear` — advance/retreat 12 months
- `SetMonth { month: u8 }` / `SetYear { year: i32 }` — jump to explicit month/year
- `FocusIn` / `FocusOut` — grid focus enter/leave
- `KeyDown { key: KeyboardKey, shift: bool }` — keyboard navigation
- `SyncProps(Box<Props>)` — props synchronization

**Context Struct** (`calendar/mod.rs:638-753`)
- `value: Bindable<Option<CalendarDate>>` — single-select value
- `selected_dates: Bindable<SelectedDates>` — multi-select set (custom `Vec<CalendarDate>` wrapper, sorted by `CalendarDate::compare`)
- `selection_mode: SelectionMode` — `Single` or `Multiple`
- `max_selected: Option<usize>` — cap on multi-select count
- `focused_date: CalendarDate` — currently keyboard-focused cell
- `visible_month: u8` / `visible_year: i32` — first visible month (1-based)
- `visible_months: usize` — count of side-by-side months (>= 1)

- Selected date (single): Not directly exposed; use `is_selected(&date)` to check, or inspect `ctx.value` directly (no public accessor for the value itself in Api!)
- Selected dates (multi): Not directly exposed; iterate dates and check `is_selected(&date)`, or inspect `ctx.selected_dates` directly

**Note**: Calendar exposes **state predicates** (is_selected, is_today) rather than direct value accessors. To get actual selected value(s), you must either:
1. Call the event handlers and listen for mutations
2. Access `ctx.value` / `ctx.selected_dates` directly in your integration

### **CRITICAL PATTERNS FOR DATEPICKER COMPOSITION**

#### **Value Sync Flow**

| Component | Holds | Type | Access | Sync Point |
|-----------|-------|------|--------|-----------|
| **DateField** | Single date (editable segments) | `CalendarDate` | `Api::value()` → `Option<&CalendarDate>` | Emits when all segments complete + clamp to min/max |
| **Calendar** | Single-select OR multi-select | `CalendarDate` \| `SelectedDates` | State predicates only (no value accessor!) | External event handlers must capture selections |

**For DatePicker**: 
- DateField's `Api::value()` gives you the parsed date → pass to Calendar's `Event::FocusDate { date }` or `Event::SelectDate { date }`
- Calendar's `Api::is_selected(&date)` tells you what's selected → **no public getter for the value itself**; must listen to `on_cell_click` / selection events and maintain parent state

#### **Props Binding Model**

Both use `Bindable<T>` (controlled/uncontrolled):
- `value: Option<Option<T>>` in Props means:
  - `None` → uncontrolled (uses internal default)
  - `Some(None)` → controlled, empty
  - `Some(Some(t))` → controlled, has value
- **DateField**: also has `pending_controlled_value` to defer external updates during active segment editing
- **Calendar**: clamps `focused_date` into `[min, max]` on props change; no pending buffer

#### **Event Models**

**DateField**: Small, segment-centric events
- Stateless type-ahead with effect-based auto-commit (`TypeBufferCommit` effect)
- Validates segment values within ranges; auto-advances to next segment when buffer filled

**Calendar**: Large, date-centric events
- Navigation events (`NextMonth`, `SetMonth`, etc.) automatically emit `AnnounceMonth` effect
- Selection mode (`Single` vs `Multiple`) changes event routing (`SelectDate` → `ToggleDate` in multi mode)
- Roving tabindex (focused cell at 0, rest at -1)

#### **Guards & State Predicates**

**DateField**:
- `disabled` blocks all edits except controlled value updates
- `readonly` blocks all edits but allows focus
- `is_composing` blocks type-ahead (IME in progress)

**Calendar**:
- `disabled` blocks all events **except** `FocusOut` and `SyncProps` (to handle disable/enable transitions)
- `readonly` blocks selection but allows navigation
- Unavailable dates remain focusable but non-selectable (predicate-based)

#### **Anatomy / Parts**

**DateField anatomy** (8 parts):
- Root, Label, FieldGroup, Segment (per kind), Literal, Description, ErrorMessage, HiddenInput

**Calendar anatomy** (12 parts):
- Root, Header, PrevTrigger, NextTrigger, Heading, Grid, GridGroup (multi-month), HeadRow, HeadCell, Row, Cell, CellTrigger

DatePicker would add:
- Popover (overlay/positioning)
- Trigger button (alignment to DateField)
- Overlay close handler

#### **Message/Label Localization**

Both depend on:
- `Messages` struct with `MessageFn` callbacks
- `Locale` from `Env`
- `IntlBackend` for calendar math labels
- `ComponentMessages` trait for message propagation

**For DatePicker**: Use same `Env` / `IntlBackend` for both sub-components; coordinate message structs if needed.

impl<M: Machine> PendingEffect<M> {

    ) -> Self

#### Machine Trait (lines 730-835)
```rust
pub trait Machine: Sized + 'static {
    type State: Clone + Debug + PartialEq;
    type Event: Clone + Debug;
    type Context: Clone + Debug;
    type Props: Clone + PartialEq + HasId;
    type Messages: ComponentMessages + Clone + Default + 'static;
    type Effect: EffectName;
    type Api<'a>: ConnectApi where Self: 'a;
    
    fn init(
        props: &Self::Props,
        env: &Env,
        messages: &Self::Messages,
    ) -> (Self::State, Self::Context);
    
    fn transition(
        state: &Self::State,
        event: &Self::Event,
        context: &Self::Context,
        props: &Self::Props,
    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>>;
    
    fn connect<'a>(
        state: &'a Self::State,
        context: &'a Self::Context,
        props: &'a Self::Props,
        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
    ) -> Self::Api<'a>;
    
    fn on_props_changed(_old: &Self::Props, _new: &Self::Props) -> Vec<Self::Event>;
    
    fn initial_effects(
        _state: &Self::State,
        _context: &Self::Context,
        _props: &Self::Props,
    ) -> Vec<PendingEffect<Self>>;
}
```

### 7. COMPOSITION PATTERN: NO NESTED STATE MACHINES IN CORE

**Critical Finding:** The ars-ui codebase does **NOT** embed child state machines inside parent machines' Context or Service fields.

**Pattern Used Instead:**
- **Presence is composed at the adapter layer** — Popover documentation explicitly states (line 158): "Mount/unmount animation lifecycle is delegated to the [`Presence`](super::presence) machine and composed by the adapter."
- **Each machine is autonomous** — Dialog, Popover, Select, Listbox, etc. are independent state machines
- **Event forwarding happens at the adapter level** — Framework adapters (Leptos, Dioxus) wrap multiple `Service<M>` instances in reactive signals and coordinate them
- **No "parent owns child Service" pattern** — No Context fields store `Service<ChildMachine>` instances

**Why:** The core machine engine is deliberately **framework-agnostic** and **stateless**. Services are created and managed at the framework adapter layer where:
- Reactive signals (Leptos `StoredValue`, Dioxus `Signal`) hold multiple `Service<M>` instances
- Event dispatching between machines is orchestrated by component-level logic
- Effect lifecycle (setup/cleanup) is tied to framework component lifecycle

**Example for DatePicker:**
Your DatePicker would:
1. Maintain two independent `Service<PopoverMachine>` and `Service<CalendarMachine>` at the adapter layer
2. Forward `Event::Open` from the Popover to show the Calendar
3. Forward `Event::SelectDate` from the Calendar into the Popover's `on_interact_outside` callback
4. Manage the relationship via adapter state, not core state machine nesting

---

### 8. ARIA WIRING IN POPOVER (Critical for DatePicker)

**Trigger Element (`Api::trigger_attrs()` lines 990-1013):**
```rust
attrs
    .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::HasPopup), "dialog")  // ← Hard-coded as "dialog"
    .set(
        HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Expanded),
        if self.is_open() { "true" } else { "false" },
    );

if self.is_open() {
    attrs.set(
        HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Controls),
        self.ctx.content_id.clone(),  // "popover-content"
    );
}
```

**Content Element (`Api::content_attrs()` lines 1049-1079):**
```rust
let role = if self.ctx.modal { "dialog" } else { "group" };

attrs
    .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.content_id.clone())
    .set(HtmlAttr::Role, role)
    .set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, "-1");

if self.ctx.modal {
    attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Modal), "true");
}

if let Some(title_id) = &self.ctx.title_id {
    attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::LabelledBy), title_id.clone());
}

if let Some(description_id) = &self.ctx.description_id {
    attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy), description_id.clone());
}
```

**For DatePicker with Calendar:**
- DatePicker trigger should emit `aria-haspopup="dialog"` (already true for Popover)
- DatePicker trigger should emit `aria-controls="calendar-content"`
- Calendar content should have `role="group"` (if non-modal) or `role="dialog"` (if modal)
- Calendar should register a title (e.g., "Select a date") via `Event::RegisterTitle`

---

### 9. KEY TAKEAWAYS FOR DATEPICKER DESIGN

1. **Use Popover state machine as-is** — It already handles open/close, focus management, outside dismissal, and ARIA wiring
2. **Compose at the adapter layer** — Create separate `Service<PopoverMachine>` and `Service<CalendarMachine>` in your framework adapter
3. **Wire the trigger `aria-haspopup` and `aria-controls`** — Popover already does this; ensure Calendar content has matching `id`
4. **Emit `Event::RegisterTitle` from Calendar** — This wires `aria-labelledby` automatically
5. **Coordinate state via event forwarding** — When Popover closes, fire `Event::Close` on Calendar; when Calendar selects a date, fire `Event::Close` on Popover
6. **Reuse DismissAttempt for veto callbacks** — Popover and Calendar both support `on_escape_key_down` and `on_interact_outside` callbacks that can prevent dismissal
7. **Let Presence handle animation** — If DatePicker needs enter/exit animations, compose Presence at the adapter layer (don't nest it in the core machine)
8. **Focus management** — Popover's `Effect::FocusInitial` and `Effect::RestoreFocus` handle focus; Calendar should cooperate by having tabbable elements

### 4. **Property-Based Testing (Proptest)** (`crates/ars-components/tests/proptest_state_machines/date_time.rs`)

**Existing Calendar + DateField + TimeField proptest blocks**

**Pattern to extend for DatePicker:**

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
enum DatePickerAction {
    Send(date_picker::Event),
    SetControlledValue(Option<CalendarDate>),
    SetOpen(bool),
    SetDisabled(bool),
    SetReadonly(bool),
}

fn date_picker_props() -> date_picker::Props {
    date_picker::Props::new()
        .id("picker")
        .label("Date")
}

fn arb_date() -> impl Strategy<Value = CalendarDate> {
    (1900i32..=2100, 1u8..=12, 1u8..=28)
        .prop_map(|(year, month, day)| date(year, month, day))
}

fn arb_date_picker_event() -> impl Strategy<Value = date_picker::Event> {
    prop_oneof![
        Just(date_picker::Event::Open),
        Just(date_picker::Event::Close),
        Just(date_picker::Event::Toggle),
        arb_date().prop_map(|date| date_picker::Event::SelectDate { date }),
        "[0-9a-zA-Z/]{0,10}".prop_map(|value| date_picker::Event::InputChange { value }),
        Just(date_picker::Event::FocusIn),
        Just(date_picker::Event::FocusOut),
    ]
}

proptest! {
    #![proptest_config(super::common::proptest_config())]

    #[test]
    #[ignore = "proptest — nightly extended-proptest job"]
    fn proptest_date_picker_event_sequences_preserve_invariants(
        actions in prop::collection::vec(
            prop_oneof![
                arb_date_picker_event().prop_map(DatePickerAction::Send),
                arb_date().prop_map(|d| DatePickerAction::SetControlledValue(Some(d))),
                Just(DatePickerAction::SetControlledValue(None)),
                any::<bool>().prop_map(DatePickerAction::SetOpen),
                any::<bool>().prop_map(DatePickerAction::SetDisabled),
                any::<bool>().prop_map(DatePickerAction::SetReadonly),
            ],
            0..128,
        ),
    ) {
        let mut service = Service::<date_picker::Machine>::new(
            date_picker_props(),
            &Env::default(),
            &date_picker::Messages::default(),
        );

        for action in actions {
            match action {
                DatePickerAction::Send(event) => {
                    drop(service.send(event));
                }
                DatePickerAction::SetControlledValue(value) => {
                    drop(service.set_props(date_picker_props().value(value)));
                }
                DatePickerAction::SetOpen(open) => {
                    drop(service.set_props(date_picker_props().open(Some(open))));
                }
                DatePickerAction::SetDisabled(value) => {
                    drop(service.set_props(date_picker_props().disabled(value)));
                }
                DatePickerAction::SetReadonly(value) => {
                    drop(service.set_props(date_picker_props().readonly(value)));
                }
            }

            let ctx = service.context();

            // Invariant: ID is always set
            prop_assert_eq!(ctx.ids.id(), "picker");

            // Invariant: state is valid
            match service.state() {
                date_picker::State::Closed => {}
                date_picker::State::Open => {}
            }

            // Invariant: if value is set, input_text reflects it
            if let Some(value) = ctx.value.get() {
                prop_assert!(!ctx.input_text.is_empty());
            }

            // Invariant: disabled state blocks state changes
            if ctx.disabled {
                prop_assert_eq!(*service.state(), date_picker::State::Closed);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

    Config {

### 6. **Snapshot Count Enforcement**

**Policy (from `spec/testing/13-policies.md`):**

- **Per-variant floor:** Canonical `ars-components` machine modules require **≥1 snapshot per state variant**
- **Formula budget:** `min(3 × state_variants × anatomy_parts, 40)` per component
- **Hard ceiling:** No component exceeds 40 snapshots (protects review fatigue)

**For DatePicker:**
- States: 2 (Closed, Open)
- Parts: 11 (Root, Label, Control, Input, Trigger, ClearTrigger, Positioner, Content, Description, ErrorMessage, HiddenInput)
- **Min snapshots:** 2 × 1 = **2** (one per variant)
- **Budget:** `min(3 × 2 × 11, 40)` = **40** (capped at ceiling)
- **Expected:** ~20-24 snapshots (realistic mid-range)

**Enforcement command:**
```bash
cargo xtask lint snapshot-count
```

**Output checking:**
```
✓ date-picker: 22 snapshots (budget: 40, min: 2) — OK
```

**CI integration:** Job `cargo xtask ci snapshot-count` runs in GitHub Actions (see `spec/testing/14-ci.md` §2.4)

13	# DatePicker
14	
15	`DatePicker` is a composite component that combines a `DateField` (segmented date input) with a `Calendar` in a popover.
16	
17	The DatePicker composes two internal machines:
18	
19	- A `DateField` machine handles the input segments.
20	- A `Calendar` machine handles the popover calendar grid.
21	- The DatePicker's own state machine manages the popover open/close lifecycle and synchronizes the selected value between the two sub-components.
22

127	/// Format a CalendarDate according to the given pattern and locale.
128	fn format_date(date: &CalendarDate, format: &str, locale: &Locale) -> String {
129	    // Production: ICU4X DateTimeFormatter.
130	    // Simplified placeholder for the spec:
131	    format!("{:02}/{:02}/{:04}", date.month.get(), date.day.get(), date.year)
132	}
133	
134	/// Parse a date string according to the given pattern and locale.
135	fn parse_date(text: &str, format: &str, locale: &Locale) -> Option<CalendarDate> {
136	    // Production: ICU4X DateTimeParser.
137	    // Simplified placeholder for the spec:
138	    let parts = text.split('/').collect::<Vec<_>>();
139	    if parts.len() != 3 { return None; }
140	    let month = parts[0].parse::<u8>().ok()?;
141	    let day   = parts[1].parse::<u8>().ok()?;
142	    let year  = parts[2].parse::<i32>().ok()?;
143	    if month < 1 || month > 12 || day < 1 || day > 31 { return None; }
144	    Some(CalendarDate::new_gregorian(
145	        year,
146	        NonZero::new(month).expect("parsed month is 1-based"),
147	        NonZero::new(day).expect("parsed day is 1-based"),
148	    ))
149	}

247	### 1.6 Composition with Calendar
248	
249	The DatePicker does not re-implement calendar logic. Instead, its `Content` part renders a `Calendar` component. The adapter is responsible for:
250	
251	1. Creating a `Calendar` `Service` using `api.calendar_props()`.
252	2. Rendering the Calendar inside the `Content` element.
253	3. Wiring the Calendar's `SelectDate` event back to the DatePicker as `Event::SelectDate { date }`.
254	4. Synchronizing the `value` Bindable so the Calendar reflects the DatePicker's current value.
255	
256	```rust
257	// Pseudocode: Leptos adapter composition
258	#[component]
259	fn DatePicker(props: DatePickerProps) -> impl IntoView {
260	    let (state, ctx, send) = use_machine::<date_picker::Machine>(/* ... */);
261	    let api = date_picker::Machine::connect(&state, &ctx, &props, &send);
262	
263	    view! {
264	        <div {..api.root_attrs()}>
265	            <label {..api.label_attrs()}>{&props.label}</label>
266	            <div {..api.control_attrs()}>
267	                <input {..api.input_attrs()}
268	                    on:input=move |e| api.on_input_change(&event_target_value(&e))
269	                    on:keydown=move |e| api.on_input_keydown(&e.key())
270	                />
271	                <button {..api.trigger_attrs()}
272	                    on:click=move |_| api.on_trigger_click()
273	                    on:keydown=move |e| api.on_trigger_keydown(&e.key())
274	                >
275	                    <CalendarIcon />
276	                </button>
277	            </div>
278	            <div {..api.positioner_attrs()}>
279	                <div {..api.content_attrs()}
280	                    on:keydown=move |e| api.on_content_keydown(&e.key())
281	                >
282	                    // Calendar composed here, with events bridged back.
283	                    <Calendar
284	                        props=api.calendar_props()
285	                        on_select=move |date| send(date_picker::Event::SelectDate { date })
286	                    />
287	                </div>
288	            </div>
289	            <input {..api.hidden_input_attrs()} />
290	        </div>
291	    }
292	}
293	```

295	### 1.7 Full Machine Implementation
296	
297	```rust
298	pub struct Machine;
299	
300	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
301	    type State   = State;
302	    type Event   = Event;
303	    type Context = Context;
304	    type Props   = Props;
305	    type Messages = Messages;
306	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
307	
308	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
309	        let value = match props.value {
310	            Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v),
311	            None    => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value.clone()),
312	        };
313	
314	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
315	        let messages = messages.clone();
316	
317	        let locale_tag = locale.to_bcp47();
318	        let default_format = match locale_tag.as_str() {
319	            "en-US" | "en-CA" => "MM/dd/yyyy",
320	            "en-GB" | "de-DE" | "fr-FR" | "es-ES" | "it-IT" | "ru-RU" => "dd/MM/yyyy",
321	            "ja-JP" | "zh-CN" | "zh-TW" | "ko-KR" => "yyyy/MM/dd",
322	            _ => "MM/dd/yyyy",
323	        };
324	        let format = props
325	            .format
326	            .clone()
327	            .unwrap_or_else(|| default_format.to_string());
328	
329	        let input_text = value
330	            .get()
331	            .as_ref()
332	            .map(|d| format_date(d, &format, &locale))
333	            .unwrap_or_default();
334	
335	        let open = match props.open {
336	            Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v),
337	            None    => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_open),
338	        };
339	
340	        let ctx = Context {
341	            value,
342	            open,
343	            input_text,
344	            parsed_date: None,
345	            locale,
346	            messages,
347	            format,
348	            min: props.min.clone(),
349	            max: props.max.clone(),
350	            disabled: props.disabled,
351	            readonly: props.readonly,
352	            open_on_click: props.open_on_click,
353	            unavailable_dates: Vec::new(),
354	            is_touched: false,
355	            name: props.name.clone(),
356	            required: props.required,
357	            is_rtl: props.is_rtl,
358	            ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),
359	        };
360	
361	        let initial_state = if *open.get() { State::Open } else { State::Closed };
362	
363	        (initial_state, ctx)
364	    }
365	
366	    fn transition(
367	        state: &Self::State,
368	        event: &Self::Event,
369	        ctx: &Self::Context,
370	        props: &Self::Props,
371	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
372	        if ctx.disabled { return None; }
373	
374	        match event {
375	            // ── Popover open / close ─────────────────────────────────────
376	            Event::Open => {
377	                if *state == State::Open || ctx.readonly { return None; }
378	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Open)
379	                    .apply(|ctx| {
380	                        ctx.open.set(true);
381	                    })
382	                    .with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus-calendar", |ctx, _props, _send| {
383	                        let platform = use_platform_effects();
384	                        let grid_id = ctx.ids.part("grid");
385	                        platform.focus_element_by_id(&grid_id);
386	                        no_cleanup()
387	                    })))
388	            }
389	
390	            Event::Close => {
391	                if *state == State::Closed { return None; }
392	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Closed)
393	                    .apply(|ctx| {
394	                        ctx.open.set(false);
395	                    })
396	                    .with_effect(PendingEffect::new("restore-focus", |ctx, _props, _send| {
397	                        let platform = use_platform_effects();
398	                        let trigger_id = ctx.ids.part("trigger");
399	                        platform.focus_element_by_id(&trigger_id);
400	                        no_cleanup()
401	                    })))
402	            }
403	
404	            Event::Toggle => {
405	                match state {
406	                    State::Closed => Self::transition(state, &Event::Open, ctx, props),
407	                    State::Open   => Self::transition(state, &Event::Close, ctx, props),
408	                }
409	            }
410	
411	            // ── Date selection (from calendar) ───────────────────────────
412	            Event::SelectDate { date } => {
413	                if ctx.readonly { return None; }
414	                let date = date.clone();
415	                let format = ctx.format.clone();
416	                let locale = ctx.locale.clone();
417	                let should_close = props.close_on_select;
418	                let next_state = if should_close { State::Closed } else { State::Open };
419	                let mut plan = TransitionPlan::to(next_state)
420	                    .apply(move |ctx| {
421	                        ctx.value.set(Some(date.clone()));
422	                        ctx.input_text = format_date(&date, &format, &locale);
423	                        ctx.parsed_date = Some(date);
424	                        if should_close {
425	                            ctx.open.set(false);
426	                        }
427	                        ctx.is_touched = true;
428	                    });
429	                if should_close {
430	                    plan = plan.with_effect(PendingEffect::new("restore-focus-after-select", |ctx, _props, _send| {
431	                        let platform = use_platform_effects();
432	                        let input_id = ctx.ids.part("input");
433	                        platform.focus_element_by_id(&input_id);
434	                        no_cleanup()
435	                    }));
436	                }
437	                Some(plan)
438	            }
439	
440	            // ── Input text change ────────────────────────────────────────
441	            Event::InputChange { value } => {
442	                if ctx.readonly { return None; }
443	                let text = value.clone();
444	                let format = ctx.format.clone();
445	                let locale = ctx.locale.clone();
446	                let min = ctx.min.clone();
447	                let max = ctx.max.clone();
448	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
449	                    ctx.is_touched = true;
450	                    // Attempt to parse the input.
451	                    if let Some(date) = parse_date(&text, &format, &locale) {
452	                        // Validate against min/max.
453	                        let in_range = min.as_ref().map_or(true, |m| date >= *m)
454	                            && max.as_ref().map_or(true, |m| date <= *m);
455	                        if in_range {
456	                            ctx.parsed_date = Some(date.clone());
457	                            ctx.value.set(Some(date));
458	                        }
459	                    } else {
460	                        // If text is empty, clear the value.
461	                        if text.is_empty() {
462	                            ctx.parsed_date = None;
463	                            ctx.value.set(None);
464	                        }
465	                    }
466	                    ctx.input_text = text;
467	                }))
468	            }
469	
470	            // ── Focus management ─────────────────────────────────────────
471	            Event::FocusIn => {
472	                if *state == State::Closed && ctx.open_on_click {
473	                    Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Open)
474	                        .apply(|ctx| {
475	                            ctx.open.set(true);
476	                        })
477	                        .with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus-calendar", |ctx, _props, _send| {
478	                            let platform = use_platform_effects();
479	                            let grid_id = ctx.ids.part("grid");
480	                            platform.focus_element_by_id(&grid_id);
481	                            no_cleanup()
482	                        })))
483	                } else {
484	                    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|_ctx| {
485	                        // No state change; just marks that the component has focus.
486	                    }))
487	                }
488	            }
489	
490	            Event::FocusOut => {
491	                // Close popover if open and focus leaves the entire component.
492	                if *state == State::Open {
493	                    Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Closed)
494	                        .apply(|ctx| {
495	                            ctx.open.set(false);
496	                        }))
497	                } else {
498	                    None
499	                }
500	            }
501	
502	            // ── Keyboard shortcuts ───────────────────────────────────────
503	            Event::KeyDown { key } => {
504	                match key {
505	                    KeyboardKey::Escape if *state == State::Open => {
506	                        Self::transition(state, &Event::Close, ctx, props)
507	                    }
508	                    KeyboardKey::ArrowDown if *state == State::Closed => {
509	                        // Alt+ArrowDown opens the picker (handled at adapter level).
510	                        Self::transition(state, &Event::Open, ctx, props)
511	                    }
512	                    _ => None,
513	                }
514	            }
515	        }
516	    }
517	
518	    fn connect<'a>(
519	        state: &'a Self::State,
520	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
521	        props: &'a Self::Props,
522	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),
523	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
524	        Api { state, ctx, props, send }
525	    }
526	}

560	impl<'a> Api<'a> {
561	    // ── AttrMap getters ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
562	
563	    /// Get the root attributes.
564	    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
565	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
566	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();
567	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
568	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
569	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.id());
570	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-state"), self.state_name());
571	        if self.ctx.disabled {
572	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"), true);
573	        }
574	        if self.ctx.readonly {
575	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-readonly"), true);
576	        }
577	        if self.ctx.is_rtl {
578	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Dir, "rtl");
579	        }
580	        attrs
581	    }
582	
583	    /// Get the label attributes.
584	    pub fn label_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
585	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
586	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Label.data_attrs();
587	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
588	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
589	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("label"));
590	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::For, self.ctx.ids.part("input"));
591	        attrs
592	    }
593	
594	    /// Get the control attributes.
595	    pub fn control_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
596	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
597	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Control.data_attrs();
598	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
599	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
600	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("control"));
601	        attrs
602	    }
603	
604	    /// Get the input attributes.
605	    pub fn input_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
606	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
607	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Input.data_attrs();
608	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
609	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
610	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("input"));
611	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Type, "text");
612	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Value, &self.ctx.input_text);
613	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::HasPopup), "dialog");
614	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Expanded), if self.is_open() { "true" } else { "false" });
615	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Controls), self.ctx.ids.part("content"));
616	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::LabelledBy), self.ctx.ids.part("label"));
617	
618	        // Announce the selected date when present.
619	        if let Some(date) = &self.ctx.parsed_date {
620	            let formatted = format_date(date, &self.ctx.format, &self.ctx.locale);
621	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Description),
622	                (self.ctx.messages.selected_date_label)(&formatted, &self.ctx.locale));
623	        }
624	
625	        // Wire description and error references.
626	        let mut describedby_parts = Vec::new();
627	        if self.props.description.is_some() {
628	            describedby_parts.push(self.ctx.ids.part("description"));
629	        }
630	        if self.props.invalid {
631	            describedby_parts.push(self.ctx.ids.part("error-message"));
632	        }
633	        if !describedby_parts.is_empty() {
634	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy), describedby_parts.join(" "));
635	        }
636	
637	        if let Some(ph) = &self.props.placeholder {
638	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Placeholder, ph);
639	        }
640	        if self.ctx.disabled {
641	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Disabled, true);
642	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled), "true");
643	        }
644	        if self.ctx.readonly {
645	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::ReadOnly, true);
646	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ReadOnly), "true");
647	        }
648	        if self.ctx.required {
649	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Required), "true");
650	        }
651	        if self.props.invalid {
652	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Invalid), "true");
653	        }
654	        attrs
655	    }
656	
657	    /// Get the trigger attributes.
658	    pub fn trigger_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
659	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
660	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Trigger.data_attrs();
661	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
662	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
663	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("trigger"));
664	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label), (self.ctx.messages.trigger_label)(&self.ctx.locale));
665	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Expanded), if self.is_open() { "true" } else { "false" });
666	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Controls), self.ctx.ids.part("content"));
667	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, "0");
668	        if self.ctx.disabled {
669	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Disabled, true);
670	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled), "true");
671	        }
672	        attrs
673	    }

675	    /// Get the clear trigger attributes.
676	    pub fn clear_trigger_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
677	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
678	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::ClearTrigger.data_attrs();
679	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
680	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
681	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("clear-trigger"));
682	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label), (self.ctx.messages.clear_label)(&self.ctx.locale));
683	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, "-1");

685	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Disabled, true);

688	        // Only visible when a value is selected.

691	        }
692	        attrs
693	    }

742	    /// Get the hidden input attributes.
743	    pub fn hidden_input_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
744	        let value = self.ctx.value.get()
745	            .as_ref()
746	            .map(|d| format!("{:04}-{:02}-{:02}", d.year, d.month.get(), d.day.get()))
747	            .unwrap_or_default();
748	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
749	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::HiddenInput.data_attrs();
750	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
751	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
752	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Type, "hidden");
753	        if let Some(name) = &self.ctx.name {
754	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Name, name);
755	        }
756	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Value, value);
757	        attrs
758	    }

811	
812	    /// Build Calendar Props from the DatePicker's current state.
813	    /// The adapter creates a Calendar machine with these props inside the
814	    /// Content part and wires its SelectDate event back to this machine.
815	    pub fn calendar_props(&self) -> calendar::Props {
816	        calendar::Props {
817	            id: format!("{}-calendar", self.ctx.ids.base_id),
818	            value: Some(self.ctx.value.get().clone()),
819	            default_value: None,
820	            min: self.ctx.min.clone(),
821	            max: self.ctx.max.clone(),
822	            disabled: self.ctx.disabled,
823	            readonly: self.ctx.readonly,
824	            is_date_unavailable: self.props.is_date_unavailable,
825	            first_day_of_week: None,
826	            is_rtl: self.ctx.is_rtl,
827	            visible_months: self.props.visible_months,
828	            today: CalendarDate::new_gregorian(2024, nzu8(1), nzu8(1)), // adapter injects real today
829	            ..calendar::Props::default()
830	        }
831	    }

874	impl ConnectApi for Api<'_> {
875	    type Part = Part;
876	
877	    fn part_attrs(&self, part: Part) -> AttrMap {
878	        match part {
879	            Part::Root => self.root_attrs(),
880	            Part::Label => self.label_attrs(),
881	            Part::Control => self.control_attrs(),
882	            Part::Input => self.input_attrs(),
883	            Part::Trigger => self.trigger_attrs(),
884	            Part::ClearTrigger => self.clear_trigger_attrs(),
885	            Part::Positioner => self.positioner_attrs(),
886	            Part::Content => self.content_attrs(),
887	            Part::Description => self.description_attrs(),
888	            Part::ErrorMessage => self.error_message_attrs(),
889	            Part::HiddenInput => self.hidden_input_attrs(),
890	        }
891	    }
892	}

895	## 2. Anatomy
896	
897	| Part           | HTML Element            | Description                                          |
898	| -------------- | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
899	| `Root`         | `<div>`                 | Outermost container; `data-ars-scope="date-picker"`  |
900	| `Label`        | `<label>`               | Associated label pointing to the input               |
901	| `Control`      | `<div>`                 | Wrapper around the input and trigger button          |
902	| `Input`        | `<input>`               | Date text input (or `DateField` segments container)  |
903	| `Trigger`      | `<button>`              | Calendar icon button to toggle the popover           |
904	| `ClearTrigger` | `<button>`              | Clears the selected date; hidden when empty          |
905	| `Positioner`   | `<div>`                 | Floating positioner managed by `ars-dom` positioning |
906	| `Content`      | `<div role="dialog">`   | Popover content containing the embedded Calendar     |
907	| `Description`  | `<div>`                 | Optional help text                                   |
908	| `ErrorMessage` | `<div role="alert">`    | Validation error text                                |
909	| `HiddenInput`  | `<input type="hidden">` | ISO date string for form submission                  |
910	
911	```text
912	DatePicker (en-US, closed)
913	└── Root                                data-ars-scope="date-picker"  data-ars-state="closed"
914	    ├── Label                           <label for="{id}-input">
915	    ├── Control                         data-ars-part="control"
916	    │   ├── Input                       id="{id}-input"  aria-haspopup="dialog"
917	    │   ├── ClearTrigger                aria-label="Clear date"  [hidden when empty]
918	    │   └── Trigger                     id="{id}-trigger"  aria-label="Open calendar"
919	    ├── Positioner                      [hidden when closed]
920	    │   └── Content                     role="dialog"  aria-label="Choose date"
921	    │       └── <Calendar />            Embedded Calendar component
922	    ├── Description
923	    ├── ErrorMessage                    role="alert"
924	    └── HiddenInput                     type="hidden"  name="..."  value="2024-01-15"
925	
926	DatePicker (en-US, open)
927	└── Root                                data-ars-state="open"
928	    ├── Label
929	    ├── Control
930	    │   ├── Input                       aria-expanded="true"
931	    │   ├── ClearTrigger
932	    │   └── Trigger                     aria-expanded="true"
933	    ├── Positioner
934	    │   └── Content                     role="dialog"  aria-modal="false"
935	    │       └── <Calendar
936	    │               value={synced from DatePicker}
937	    │               min={forwarded}
938	    │               max={forwarded}
939	    │               locale={forwarded}
940	    │           />
941	    └── HiddenInput
942	```
943	
944	## 3. Accessibility
945	
946	### 3.1 ARIA Roles, States, and Properties
947	
948	| Element        | Role/Attribute        | Details                                                                      |
949	| -------------- | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
950	| `Input`        | `<input type="text">` | `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` points to Content |
951	| `Trigger`      | `<button>`            | `aria-label="Open calendar"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`               |
952	| `Content`      | `role="dialog"`       | `aria-label="Choose date"`                                                   |
953	| `ErrorMessage` | `role="alert"`        | Announced immediately on render                                              |
954	| `Label`        | `<label>`             | `for` attribute points to Input                                              |
955	
956	### 3.2 Keyboard Interaction
957	
958	| Key               | Context                       | Action                                     |
959	| ----------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
960	| `ArrowDown`       | Input focused, popover closed | Open the calendar popover                  |
961	| `Escape`          | Popover open                  | Close the popover, return focus to trigger |
962	| `Enter` / `Space` | Trigger focused               | Toggle the popover                         |
963	| `Tab`             | Inside calendar popover       | Close the popover, move focus forward      |
964	
965	### 3.3 Focus Flow
966	
967	1. User tabs to the input or trigger.
968	2. Clicking the trigger or pressing ArrowDown on the input opens the popover.
969	3. Focus moves into the Calendar grid (first selected date, or today).
970	4. Selecting a date closes the popover and returns focus to the input.
971	5. Pressing Escape closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger.
972	6. Tab from inside the calendar closes the popover and moves focus to the next focusable element after the date picker.
973	
974	## 4. Internationalization
975	
976	### 4.1 Messages
977	
978	```rust
979	/// Messages for the DatePicker component.
980	#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
981	pub struct Messages {
982	    /// Trigger button label (default: "Open calendar").
983	    pub trigger_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
984	    /// Clear button label (default: "Clear date").

986	    /// Content dialog label (default: "Choose date").

988	    /// Announces the selected date (e.g. "Selected date: March 15, 2025").
989	    /// Used as `aria-description` on the input field when a date is selected.
990	    pub selected_date_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&str, &Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
991	}
992	// Calendar navigation labels (prev/next month, today, unavailable) belong to
993	// the embedded Calendar component's Messages — not duplicated here.
994	
995	impl Default for Messages {

997	        Self {
998	            trigger_label: MessageFn::static_str("Open calendar"),
999	            clear_label: MessageFn::static_str("Clear date"),
1000	            content_label: MessageFn::static_str("Choose date"),
1001	            selected_date_label: MessageFn::new(|date, _locale| format!("Selected date: {}", date)),
1002	        }
1003	    }
1004	}

1008	
1009	## 5. Form Integration
1010	
1011	The DatePicker participates in HTML form submission via a hidden `<input type="hidden">` element rendered by the `HiddenInput` part. The hidden input carries the selected date in ISO 8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
1012	
1013	- **`name` prop**: When set, the hidden input includes `name="{value}"` so the date is submitted with the form under that key.
1014	- **Required validation**: When `required` is `true`, the input carries `aria-required="true"`. Form validation treats an empty value as invalid.
1015	- **Reset**: On form reset, the adapter restores the initial value (the `default_value` from Props or `None`) and syncs the input text accordingly.
1016	- **`aria-describedby`**: The input's `aria-describedby` chains the Description and ErrorMessage IDs so assistive technology announces help text and validation errors.
1017	- **ISO value**: The hidden input's `value` is always the ISO 8601 representation of the selected date (e.g., `2024-03-15`), regardless of the display format used in the visible input.
1018	
1019	## 6. Library Parity
1020	
1021	> Compared against: Ark UI (`DatePicker`), React Aria (`DatePicker`).
1022	
1023	### 6.1 Props
1024	
1025	| Feature               | ars-ui                | Ark UI                       | React Aria             | Notes                                               |
1026	| --------------------- | --------------------- | ---------------------------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
1027	| Controlled value      | `value`               | `value`                      | `value`                | Equivalent                                          |
1028	| Default value         | `default_value`       | `defaultValue`               | `defaultValue`         | Equivalent                                          |
1029	| Min/max               | `min`, `max`          | `min`, `max`                 | `minValue`, `maxValue` | Equivalent                                          |
1030	| Disabled              | `disabled`            | `disabled`                   | `isDisabled`           | Equivalent                                          |
1031	| Read-only             | `readonly`            | `readOnly`                   | `isReadOnly`           | Equivalent                                          |
1032	| Invalid               | `invalid`             | `invalid`                    | `isInvalid`            | Equivalent                                          |
1033	| Required              | `required`            | `required`                   | `isRequired`           | Equivalent                                          |
1034	| Unavailable predicate | `is_date_unavailable` | `isDateUnavailable`          | `isDateUnavailable`    | Equivalent                                          |
1035	| Close on select       | `close_on_select`     | `closeOnSelect`              | `shouldCloseOnSelect`  | Equivalent                                          |
1036	| Open on click         | `open_on_click`       | `openOnClick`                | --                     | Ark UI has it; React Aria does not                  |
1037	| Locale                | `locale`              | `locale`                     | -- (context)           | Equivalent approach differs                         |
1038	| Format                | `format`              | `format`                     | --                     | Ark UI has custom format fn                         |
1039	| Placeholder           | `placeholder`         | `placeholder`                | `placeholderValue`     | React Aria uses a DateValue placeholder             |
1040	| Name                  | `name`                | `name`                       | `name`                 | Equivalent                                          |
1041	| Visible months        | `visible_months`      | `numOfMonths`                | --                     | ars-ui and Ark UI support multi-month               |
1042	| Default open          | --                    | `defaultOpen`                | `defaultOpen`          | Not present in ars-ui                               |
1043	| Controlled open       | --                    | `open`                       | `isOpen`               | Not present as a controlled prop                    |
1044	| Fixed weeks           | --                    | `fixedWeeks`                 | --                     | ars-ui always renders 6 weeks                       |
1045	| Default view          | --                    | `defaultView`                | --                     | Ark UI has month/year view switching                |
1046	| View control          | --                    | `view`, `minView`, `maxView` | --                     | Ark UI view switching not in ars-ui                 |
1047	| Selection mode        | --                    | `selectionMode`              | --                     | Ark UI uses one component for single/range/multiple |
1048	| Inline mode           | --                    | `inline`                     | --                     | ars-ui Calendar is the inline mode                  |
1049	| Start of week         | --                    | `startOfWeek`                | `firstDayOfWeek`       | Forwarded to Calendar's `first_day_of_week`         |
1050	| Time zone             | --                    | `timeZone`                   | --                     | Not applicable to date-only picker                  |
1051	| Parse function        | --                    | `parse`                      | --                     | ars-ui has internal parse_date                      |
1052	| Granularity           | --                    | --                           | `granularity`          | React Aria DatePicker can include time              |
1053	| Hour cycle            | --                    | --                           | `hourCycle`            | React Aria DatePicker can include time              |
1054	| Auto-focus            | --                    | --                           | `autoFocus`            | Adapter concern                                     |
1055	| Validation            | --                    | --                           | `validate`             | React Aria custom validation function               |
1056	| Page behavior         | --                    | --                           | `pageBehavior`         | Forwarded to Calendar                               |
1057	
1058	**Gaps:** None.
1059	
1060	### 6.2 Anatomy
1061	
1062	| Part              | ars-ui         | Ark UI                      | React Aria                  | Notes                                  |
1063	| ----------------- | -------------- | --------------------------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
1064	| Root              | `Root`         | `Root`                      | `DatePicker`                | Equivalent                             |
1065	| Label             | `Label`        | `Label`                     | `Label`                     | Equivalent                             |
1066	| Control           | `Control`      | `Control`                   | `Group`                     | Equivalent                             |
1067	| Input             | `Input`        | `Input`                     | `DateInput` + `DateSegment` | React Aria uses segments               |
1068	| Trigger           | `Trigger`      | `Trigger`                   | `Button`                    | Equivalent                             |
1069	| Clear trigger     | `ClearTrigger` | `ClearTrigger`              | --                          | React Aria has no clear button         |
1070	| Positioner        | `Positioner`   | `Positioner`                | --                          | React Aria uses Popover directly       |
1071	| Content           | `Content`      | `Content`                   | `Popover` + `Dialog`        | Equivalent                             |
1072	| Calendar          | (composed)     | Calendar parts              | `Calendar`                  | Composed inside content                |
1073	| Description       | `Description`  | --                          | `Text` (slot)               | Equivalent                             |
1074	| Error message     | `ErrorMessage` | --                          | `FieldError`                | Equivalent                             |
1075	| Hidden input      | `HiddenInput`  | --                          | --                          | ars-ui form integration                |
1076	| Value text        | --             | `ValueText`                 | --                          | Ark UI has a formatted value text part |
1077	| Preset trigger    | --             | `PresetTrigger`             | --                          | Ark UI has preset date buttons         |
1078	| Month/year select | --             | `MonthSelect`, `YearSelect` | --                          | Ark UI has dropdown selects            |
1079	
1080	**Gaps:** None worth adopting. `ValueText`, `PresetTrigger`, and `MonthSelect`/`YearSelect` are Ark UI-specific conveniences. ars-ui exposes `formatted_value()` on the API for value text, and month/year selection is handled by Calendar's `SetMonth`/`SetYear` events.
1081	
1082	### 6.3 Events
1083	
1084	| Callback             | ars-ui                       | Ark UI                     | React Aria                           | Notes                               |
1085	| -------------------- | ---------------------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------- |
1086	| Value change         | `SelectDate` / `InputChange` | `onValueChange`            | `onChange`                           | Equivalent                          |
1087	| Open change          | `Open` / `Close` events      | `onOpenChange`             | `onOpenChange`                       | Equivalent                          |
1088	| Focus change         | `FocusIn` / `FocusOut`       | `onFocusChange` (calendar) | `onFocus`, `onBlur`, `onFocusChange` | Equivalent                          |
1089	| View change          | --                           | `onViewChange`             | --                                   | Ark UI view switching               |
1090	| Visible range change | --                           | `onVisibleRangeChange`     | --                                   | Ark UI calendar navigation callback |
1091	
1092	**Gaps:** None. View change and visible range change are Ark UI-specific features tied to their view switching model.
1093	
1094	### 6.4 Features
1095	
1096	| Feature                         | ars-ui                      | Ark UI | React Aria               |
1097	| ------------------------------- | --------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------ |
1098	| Text input with parsing         | Yes                         | Yes    | No (segments only)       |
1099	| Segmented input                 | No (delegates to DateField) | No     | Yes                      |
1100	| Calendar popover                | Yes                         | Yes    | Yes                      |
1101	| Close on select                 | Yes                         | Yes    | Yes                      |
1102	| Open on click                   | Yes                         | Yes    | No                       |
1103	| Clear button                    | Yes                         | Yes    | No                       |
1104	| Multi-month calendar            | Yes                         | Yes    | No (at DatePicker level) |
1105	| Inline mode                     | No (use Calendar)           | Yes    | No                       |
1106	| View switching (day/month/year) | No                          | Yes    | No                       |
1107	| Preset triggers                 | No                          | Yes    | No                       |
1108	| Month/year dropdown select      | No                          | Yes    | No                       |
1109	| Custom format/parse             | Yes                         | Yes    | No                       |
1110	| Hidden form input               | Yes                         | No     | No                       |
1111	| Form validation                 | Yes                         | No     | Yes                      |
1112	
1113	**Gaps:** None worth adopting. Ark UI's view switching and preset triggers are nice-to-haves but add significant complexity; ars-ui's Calendar already supports `SetMonth`/`SetYear` for programmatic navigation.
1114	
1115	### 6.5 Summary
1116	
1117	- **Overall:** Full parity with both libraries.
1118	- **Divergences:** Ark UI has view switching (day/month/year views) and preset triggers. React Aria uses segmented input by default (ars-ui delegates to DateField). ars-ui supports both text input and composed DateField approaches.
1119	- **Recommended additions:** None.
1120

Key confirmation: `type Effect: EffectName` is required (blanket impl for `Copy+Debug+Eq+Hash+Send+Sync`), and `PendingEffect::named(name)` is the marker-only form where "the adapter implements the behavior based on the name alone." The spec §1.7 omits `type Effect` and uses closures calling `use_platform_effects()` for focus — which both fails to compile (no associated type) and contradicts the issue's element/ref note. Let me verify the Calendar/Popover effect conventions and the `CalendarDate`/`calendar::Props`/`ComponentIds` APIs.

202	/// Ordered set of unique calendar dates, sorted by
203	/// [`CalendarDate::compare`].
204	///
205	/// [`CalendarDate`] implements neither [`Ord`] nor [`PartialOrd`] (different
206	/// calendar systems share the same `CalendarDate` value type, so global
207	/// ordering is undefined), but it does expose a chronological
208	/// [`compare`](CalendarDate::compare) method. `SelectedDates` is a thin
209	/// newtype wrapper around `Vec<CalendarDate>` that maintains sorted order
210	/// using that comparator, plays the role of `SelectedDates` for the
211	/// multi-select variant, and stays usable without any extra trait impls on
212	/// the foreign type.
213	#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
214	pub struct SelectedDates {
215	    dates: Vec<CalendarDate>,
216	}
217	
218	impl SelectedDates {
219	    /// Creates an empty set.
220	    #[must_use]
221	    pub const fn new() -> Self {
222	        Self { dates: Vec::new() }
223	    }
224	
225	    /// Returns the number of selected dates.
226	    #[must_use]
227	    pub const fn len(&self) -> usize {
228	        self.dates.len()
229	    }
230	
231	    /// Whether the set is empty.
232	    #[must_use]
233	    pub const fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
234	        self.dates.is_empty()
235	    }
236	
237	    /// Iterates over the selected dates in chronological order.
238	    pub fn iter(&self) -> core::slice::Iter<'_, CalendarDate> {
239	        self.dates.iter()
240	    }
241	
242	    /// Returns whether `date` is in the set.
243	    #[must_use]
244	    pub fn contains(&self, date: &CalendarDate) -> bool {
245	        self.dates
246	            .binary_search_by(|candidate| candidate.compare(date))
247	            .is_ok()
248	    }
249	
250	    /// Inserts `date` into the set, returning `true` if it was newly added.
251	    pub fn insert(&mut self, date: CalendarDate) -> bool {
252	        if let Err(idx) = self
253	            .dates
254	            .binary_search_by(|candidate| candidate.compare(&date))
255	        {
256	            self.dates.insert(idx, date);
257	
258	            true
259	        } else {
260	            false
261	        }
262	    }
263	
264	    /// Removes `date` from the set, returning `true` if it was present.
265	    pub fn remove(&mut self, date: &CalendarDate) -> bool {
266	        if let Ok(idx) = self
267	            .dates
268	            .binary_search_by(|candidate| candidate.compare(date))
269	        {
270	            self.dates.remove(idx);
271	
272	            true
273	        } else {
274	            false
275	        }
276	    }
277	
278	    /// Returns the underlying sorted slice.
279	    #[must_use]
280	    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[CalendarDate] {
281	        &self.dates
282	    }
283	}
284	
285	impl FromIterator<CalendarDate> for SelectedDates {
286	    fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = CalendarDate>>(iter: I) -> Self {
287	        let mut set = Self::new();
288	
289	        for date in iter {
290	            set.insert(date);
291	        }
292	
293	        set
294	    }
295	}
296	
297	impl<'a> IntoIterator for &'a SelectedDates {
298	    type Item = &'a CalendarDate;
299	    type IntoIter = core::slice::Iter<'a, CalendarDate>;
300	
301	    fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter {
302	        self.dates.iter()
303	    }
304	}

306	/// Predicate type for marking dates unavailable.
307	///
308	/// Unavailable dates remain focusable for keyboard navigation but cannot
309	/// be selected. Wrapped in [`Callback`] so applications can supply
310	/// closures with captured state (allowlists, computed holiday tables,
311	/// etc.); the `Arc`-backed pointer equality keeps `Props` `Clone +
312	/// PartialEq` without the function-pointer comparison foot-gun.
313	pub type IsDateUnavailableFn = Callback<dyn for<'a> Fn(&'a CalendarDate) -> bool + Send + Sync>;

763	    /// full bound rationale.

779	        env: &Env,
780	        messages: &Self::Messages,

788	        event: &Self::Event,
789	        context: &Self::Context,
790	        props: &Self::Props,
791	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>>;

797	        props: &'a Self::Props,

804	    /// that are enqueued for processing (e.g., `SetValue`, `SetMode`).
805	    fn on_props_changed(_old: &Self::Props, _new: &Self::Props) -> Vec<Self::Event> {
806	        Vec::new()

812	    /// `init` returns the initial `(state, context)` directly, which means
813	    /// no [`transition`](Machine::transition) ever runs for the boot-up
814	    /// configuration — the lifecycle effects bound to that transition (e.g.

816	    /// inside the open content") are therefore never emitted. When a machine

818	    /// `default_mounted: true`, …) it MUST override this method to return the
819	    /// effect set the equivalent transition would have produced.
820	    ///

828	    fn initial_effects(

830	        _context: &Self::Context,

832	    ) -> Vec<PendingEffect<Self>> {
833	        Vec::new()
834	    }
835	}
836	
837	// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
838	// SendResult and Service
839	// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

841	/// Maximum number of events processed per [`Service::send`] call before
842	/// breaking to prevent infinite transition loops.
843	const MAX_DRAIN_ITERATIONS: usize = 100;
844	
845	#[cfg(feature = "debug")]
846	fn format_effect_names<M: Machine>(effects: &[PendingEffect<M>]) -> String {
847	    let mut formatted = String::from("[");
848	
849	    for (index, effect) in effects.iter().enumerate() {
850	        if index > 0 {
851	            formatted.push_str(", ");
852	        }
853	
854	        formatted.push_str(&format!("{:?}", effect.name));
855	    }
856	
857	    formatted.push(']');

# Task #289 — Implement DatePicker agnostic core

## Context

GitHub issue #289 (epic #224, 8 pts) asks for the framework-agnostic `DatePicker`
state machine: a composite that pairs a date **text input** with an embedded
`Calendar` in a popover, owning popover open/close, date selection, input
parsing/validation, value↔calendar sync, and ARIA/data attributes. Dependencies
#262 (DateField) and #280 (Calendar) are merged. Adapters (Leptos/Dioxus) are
explicitly out of scope (separate tasks); this is **unit-tested agnostic core only**.

Spec: `spec/components/date-time/date-picker.md`. Shared types: `spec/shared/date-time-types.md`.

The spec's `§1.7 Full Machine Implementation` was written before the core engine
and sibling components solidified, so it contains several **compile-blockers and
omissions** that must be fixed in code and synced back into the spec in this same
PR (CLAUDE.md: "resolve spec/code mismatch in the same task"; the issue's
"Spec impact: No spec change required" is the author's expectation, not a
prohibition — the spec literally will not compile as written).

## Decisions locked with the user

1. **Full controlled-prop sync** — add a `SyncProps(Box<Props>)` event + implement
   `on_props_changed` + `initial_effects`, matching Calendar/DateField/Popover.
2. **`aria-haspopup="dialog"` on BOTH Input and Trigger** — keep it on Input (spec)
   and add it to `trigger_attrs()` (issue's named test + Popover precedent); update
   spec §1.8 / §3.1.
3. **Format-pattern-aware** `format_date`/`parse_date` — derive field order +
   separator from the `format` string (MDY / DMY / YMD), so the computed `format`
   field and locale defaults are not dead code. Dependency-free; passes the en-US
   `MM/dd/yyyy` test.

## Spec drifts to fix (code + spec, same PR)

Verified against the real sources (not training data):

| # | Spec §1.7/§1.8 as written | Reality / fix |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | No `type Effect`; effects use string names + `use_platform_effects()`/`focus_element_by_id` closures in core | `Machine` trait requires `type Effect: EffectName`. Define a typed `Effect` enum and emit `PendingEffect::named(...)`; focus is **adapter-driven** (matches issue element/ref note + `popover`/`dialog` which use `PendingEffect::named(Effect::FocusInitial/RestoreFocus)` exclusively, never platform calls in core) |
| D2 | `is_date_unavailable: Option<fn(&CalendarDate) -> bool>` | Calendar's prop is `Option<calendar::IsDateUnavailableFn>` (= `Callback<dyn Fn(&CalendarDate)->bool + Send+Sync>`). Reuse that type so `calendar_props()` forwards cleanly and `Props` stays `Clone+PartialEq+Debug` |
| D3 | `CalendarDate` field access `d.month.get()`, `d.day.get()`, `d.year`; `NonZero::new(..)`; `nzu8(..)` helper | Fields are `pub(crate)`. Accessors are `year()->i32`, `month()->u8`, `day()->u8` (plain ints). `nzu8` does not exist anywhere. `new_gregorian(i32,u8,u8) -> Result<…>` |
| D4 | `parse_date` builds `Some(CalendarDate::new_gregorian(..))` with `NonZero`+`.expect` | `new_gregorian` returns `Result`; use `CalendarDate::new_gregorian(y,m,d).ok()` |
| D5 | min/max check via `date >= *m`, `date <= *m` | `CalendarDate` has **no** `PartialOrd`/`Ord`. Use `date.compare(m) -> Ordering` (`!= Less` / `!= Greater`) |
| D6 | `self.ctx.ids.base_id` in `calendar_props()` | No public `base_id` field; accessor is `ids.id()` |
| D7 | `Context` derives `#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]` | `Messages` (holds `MessageFn`) is not `PartialEq`; trait only needs `Clone+Debug`. Mirror Calendar: `#[derive(Clone)]` + manual `Debug` (skip messages), drop `PartialEq` |
| D8 | Machine impl omits `on_props_changed`, `initial_effects`, and a `SyncProps` event | Add all three (decision #1) |
| D9 (tests) | `Service::new(props, Env::default(), Default::default())`; bare `svc.send(..)` | `Service::new(props, &Env, &Messages)` by ref; `send` is `#[must_use]` → `drop(svc.send(..))`; use a `date(y,m,d)` helper like Calendar tests |

## Files

**Create**
- `crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_picker/mod.rs` — machine, Props, Context,
  State, Event, Effect, Messages, Part, Api.
- `crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_picker/tests.rs` — unit + snapshot tests
  (`#[cfg(test)] mod tests;` included from `mod.rs`).
- `crates/ars-components/src/date_time/date_picker/snapshots/` — committed `.snap` fixtures.

**Modify**
- `crates/ars-components/src/date_time/mod.rs` — add `pub mod date_picker;` (with `///` doc).
- `crates/ars-components/tests/spec_conformance/date_time.rs` — add DatePicker anatomy test.
- `crates/ars-components/tests/proptest_state_machines/date_time.rs` — add DatePicker proptest.
- `spec/components/date-time/date-picker.md` — sync §1.3/§1.4/§1.7/§1.8/§3.1/§4 to the
